description:
To qualify for this position, you must be an experienced Java Developer with a proven track record of delivering results in a large and complex global application. Your Web Development skills will be front and center, and your work will literally be the face of this application to users across the globe. What a fantastic opportunity! 
 
 To qualify for this position, your Web development skills must include strong and verifyable experience using the following tools and technologies: 
 In addition to the "must have" skills listed above, any experience in the following areas are preferred, and if you have these skills, then you will have the inside track on winning this position! 
 Specific responsibilities will include: 
 
 -- Playing a key role in all aspects of the UI Design, Testing, Implementation and Deployment. 
 -- Working closely with application Developers and technical management to co-produce a leading-edge global business application.
 -- Participating in design and code reviews. 
 -- Producing results in an Agile environment. 
 --  Experience : 10+ Years preferred 

 Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.


 Additional Information 

 ** U.S. citizens and those authorized to work in the U.S. are encouraged to apply.  

 Note:- 

 1.This is a contract position job opportunity for you. 
 2.Citizen and Green Card Holde can apply. 
 3.No OPT-EAD or H1B Consultants please. 
 4.Please mention your Visa Status in your email or resume.
